messages:
autoscale-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-utilization > 95% for 6m across us-west-2. autoscale attempted +10 instances but hit max_instances=50. See dashboard: https://redwood/dash/gpu-pool/us-west-2

autoscale-bot: error summary: scale_failures=3, queue_depth=12k, avg_wait=4200ms, throttle_rate=27%

jamie_oncall: oncall here, paging SRE. Impact? any customer pages?

maya_sre: paging in last 10m from customer-ops: 2 timeouts from prod-critical customers. Confirming error surface: many requests stuck in queue, token latencies > 5s.

maya_sre: metrics dump: gpu_pools/us-west-2: active_nodes=48, usable_gpus=184 (expected 240), node_flaps=3 in 15m, driver_xid=45 spikes, per-node OOMs on ml-infer-03/06

tyler_runtime: seeing repeated CUDA Xid 45 and nvml errors in runtime logs. Looks like driver kernel panic + process OOMs are causing nodes to drop from pool, autoscaler can't recover because cloud quota is hit for this account.

alice_prod_eng: customer-support flagged 2 customers with 504s. Luis, can you confirm which tenants?

luis_support: confirmed: tenant-id=acme-fin, tenant-id=orch-ai. Both reported increased 5xx and timeouts around 12:03. Logging ticket numbers in tracker.

jamie_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop scheduling new long-running jobs to GPU pool, 2) throttle non-critical tenants, 3) try manual scale up if cloud quota allows, 4) isolate flapping nodes. Who can take each?

maya_sre: I will isolate flapping nodes and cordon/drain if needed. Starting: ``kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-usw2 -o wide``

tyler_runtime: I'll check driver versions and OOM traces. Possible mitigation: revert last driver rollout (rolled 2 hours ago) or restart driver on affected nodes.

ejecmd: ``# cordon & drain node``

maya_sre: ``kubectl cordon ml-infer-03``

maya_sre: ``kubectl drain ml-infer-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force``

deploy-bot: Deploy event: driver-propagation-v2 rolled at 11:50. Rollout state: 78% complete.

tyler_runtime: that rollout correlates with first flaps. Reverting to driver-propagation-v1 on 3 affected nodes now. Command: ``/ops rollback driver-propagation-v2 --nodes ml-infer-03,ml-infer-06,ml-infer-11``

jamie_oncall: autoscaler note: quota prevents adding more nodes. Cloud account limit: GPU instances = 50. We are at 48 nodes but some are unhealthy so usable count lower. Ops: can we request emergency quota bump?

alice_prod_eng: I'll open emergency quota request with cloud support, but that's >30min. We should also free up capacity by draining batch/low-priority jobs and enforcing stricter per-tenant concurrency.

maya_sre: Draining ml-infer-03 freed 4 GPUs. Rebooting node to clear driver state: ``ssh root@ml-infer-03 'reboot'``

tyler_runtime: looking at /var/log/syslog on ml-infer-06: repeated "NVRM: Xid (45)" followed by oom_kill. Kernel OOMs triggered by driver memory leak under v2.

tyler_runtime: temp mitigation: restart nvidia-driver.service on nodes that are flapping rather than full reboot. Command: ``ssh node 'systemctl restart nvidia-driver.service'``

maya_sre: restarted driver on ml-infer-06, node back in Ready, kubelet rejoined. usable_gpus +4. Queue depth dropped from 12k -> 7.1k, avg_wait 4200ms -> 2400ms.

jamie_oncall: good. Continue restarts on remaining flappers but avoid mass restarts to not cause cascade. Also apply conn-limit to tenants: ``/control throttle --tenant acme-fin --concurrency 4``

luis_support: applying tenant throttles now. Notifying customer success to set expectations: "We're mitigating a GPU capacity issue, temporary throttling in place."

autoscale-bot: manual_scale requested by alice_prod_eng: +8 instances. Cloud API response: ERROR QuotaExceeded: cannot provision, limit 50 reached.

alice_prod_eng: we can't add more instances due to quota. Continuing draining low-priority jobs to free GPUs.

maya_sre: Started evicting non-prod pods in gpu-pool with label tier=lowprio. Commands: ``kubectl delete pod -l tier=lowprio -n */* --grace-period=5``

tyler_runtime: patch ready: rollback driver-propagation-v2 globally OR apply hotfix kernel param to limit driver memory growth. Hotfix includes sysctl tweak: ``echo 1 > /proc/sys/nvidia/enable_workaround_leak`` (internal) — applying to affected nodes only.

jamie_oncall: do not run unvetted sysctl on prod at scale. Prefer controlled rollback. Tyler, coordinate with eng release to stop rollout.

tyler_runtime: stop the rollout: ``/ops pause rollout driver-propagation-v2`` — paused. Scheduling rollback to v1 via canary 2 nodes then widen.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by tyler_runtime at 12:18. Current canary nodes preserved.

maya_sre: After manual restarts + draining lowprio, queue=3.2k, avg_wait=1300ms, throttle_rate=9%. Error 5xx rate down ~70% from peak.

jamie_oncall: customer impact summary for pager: 2 tenants saw intermittent 5xx/504, degraded latencies for multiple others. No data loss reported. Filing incident ticket and notifying CS.

luis_support: CS notified, messages sent to affected customers with ETA 30-60m.

jamie_oncall: Next steps: - finish rollback tomorrow AM across regions - request emergency GPU quota bump with cloud - postmortem: root cause driver v2 memory leak + quota headroom insufficient + autoscaler lacks graceful fallback when nodes unhealthy. Owner: tyler_runtime (runtime), reviewer: maya_sre.

tyler_runtime: taking ownership of postmortem. Will collect driver logs, rollout history, cloud quota requests.

jamie_oncall: Handoff to night oncall @maria_night in 30m with summary. I will create brief handoff note in #oncall-handoffs. Anyone else?

alice_prod_eng: I'll follow up on emergency quota with cloud sales/partner team.

maria_night (system): NOTE: oncall change scheduled at 2024-05-17T00:00:00Z — paging transferred.

jamie_oncall: thanks team. Keeping thread open for any regressions. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: adding quick log excerpt for postmortem:
```
[ml-infer-06] May 17 11:58:22 kernel: NVRM: Xid (45): 0xb3e...
[ml-infer-06] May 17 11:58:23 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (python) total-vm:...
[autoscaler] 12:05:10 scale up failed: quota exceeded, attempted=8, allowed=0
```
